Uniform across tones so the family reads as one system.

session10.architectureResolved: Bill on top (statement of charges to a total due), then the payment plan against it, and that plan IS the transaction history. Settled installments are the history, scheduled ones are the schedule, a today marker is the only divider, so no payment is ever stated twice. Recorded on the module shelf index. The three screen divergences stand as the record of how that conclusion was reached; D2's separate Payment history card is the option the conclusion rejects.
